teaser: A half-signed petition waits on the counter, replaced this morning by a better cause. That is life path 9, the Humanitarian, crossed with an ENTP, the Debater, and the particular friction is this: the number asks for devotion to something larger than the self, and the type questions every settled position before it finishes forming. You care about people in the abstract with real force, and you argue your own convictions out loud, sometimes until they thin. The causes multiply before any of them take root.
